prompt: Image 1 is the STYLE reference: match its warm sunlit terracotta-beige plaster wall with soft dappled leaf shadows, the light-oak floor and the skirting board, the lens and warm colour grading exactly, so this looks like the same photoshoot. Image 2 is a raised pet bowl: cream top with a small paw and the name РИЧИ engraved, charcoal ribbed base with a wavy border. Image 3 is a matching kibble scoop: cream and charcoal cup with a cream handle. Image 4 is a raised pet bowl made of four stacked soft sage-green rings with МИЛА engraved on the front ring. In both bowls a stainless steel bowl sits fully RECESSED inside, only its thin rim visible, filled with kibble. Create ONE tall vertical photo. The UPPER 42% of the frame is calm empty wall with soft leaf shadows only, nothing reaching into it (it will hold text). In the lower part, on the oak floor: a fawn-and-white young corgi dog and a grey British shorthair cat lying close together in the centre, the cat leaning on the dog, both looking at the camera. In front of them, slightly closer to the camera: the EXACT bowl from image 2 on the left with РИЧИ facing the camera and the EXACT scoop from image 3 lying beside it with a few kibbles spilled, and the EXACT bowl from image 4 on the right with МИЛА facing the camera. The bowls are clearly smaller than the corgi. Keep the names exactly РИЧИ and МИЛА, no other text, no logos. Photorealistic, cosy, soft late-afternoon light.
